name: Periodic Table Meta Criteria
principle: Meta layers are selectable lenses over the same atom/pill/component graph; they do not create new truth claims by themselves.

criteria.label: Dependency
criteria.description: How strongly this component is required upstream or supports downstream structure.

criteria.label: Evidence
criteria.description: Quality, directness, and coverage of admitted evidence.

criteria.label: Falsifiability
criteria.description: Clarity and force of defeat conditions, negative guards, and kill conditions.

criteria.label: Formal / Mathematical
criteria.description: Degree of formalization, derivation, proof, equation, or machine-checkable structure.

criteria.label: Internal Coherence
criteria.description: Consistency with declared assumptions, definitions, and neighboring claims.

criteria.label: Evidence Independence
criteria.description: How independent the support is across source families and methods.

criteria.label: Cross-Domain Bridge
criteria.description: Strength and warrant of mappings across distinct native domains.

criteria.label: Blast Radius
criteria.description: How much downstream structure is affected if this component fails.

criteria.label: Provenance
criteria.description: Traceability to source artifact, version, receipt, reviewer, or run.

criteria.label: Translation Stability
criteria.description: Whether the claim survives movement between technical, theological, narrative, and everyday registers without changing meaning.

criteria.label: Explanatory Yield
criteria.description: How much distinct explanatory work the component performs relative to its assumptions and complexity.

criteria.label: Novelty / Non-Redundancy
criteria.description: Whether this component adds information rather than merely restating another component.
